title: IMS segment PCB-OK → relational table
description: Program accesses IMS segment PCB-OK via PCB/SSA WS-PCB-MASK. Migrate segment to a relational table; preserve hierarchical parent foreign keys to model the DBD hierarchy.
suggestedReplacement:
-- CREATE TABLE pcb-ok (
--   id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
--   parent_id BIGINT REFERENCES <parent_segment_table>(id),
--   ...
-- );

title: EXEC SQL without SQLCODE / SQLSTATE check
description: Embedded SQL with no SQLCODE / SQLSTATE inspection after the call and no WHENEVER directive in effect. Unhandled SQL errors are a common source of silent data corruption in COBOL.
suggestedReplacement:
EXEC SQL ... END-EXEC.
    IF SQLCODE NOT = ZERO
        PERFORM HANDLE-SQL-ERROR
    END-IF.
